name: AgenticDataBench
summary: Benchmark for data-science agents: 344 tasks over 97 real datasets in 15 domains, with 433 fine-grained skill labels for skill-level scoring.
description: From Tsinghua University and Ant Digital Technologies (arXiv 2607.01647). Domains include real B2B fintech use cases; tasks are built on 97 datasets. 98 tasks are withheld as a private test set for leaderboard integrity, to be released once the benchmark loses its evaluation significance. Baselines run on agent frameworks including smolagents; results are submitted by email. Code Apache-2.0; datasets Apache-2.0 on Hugging Face (shawnzzzh/AgenticDataBench).
